title: Fix upload 'expected v3 response body' error

requirements.text: Fix the upload flow so that the backend upload/storage response is correctly parsed and conforms to the expected v3 response body format. The backend actor's blob-storage or video upload handler must return a response shape that matches what the frontend Upload page expects, eliminating the 'expected v3 response body' error when a user attempts to upload a video or photo.

quotes: When I go to upload it says expected v3 response body

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to the Upload page and submitting a video or photo file completes without throwing an 'expected v3 response body' error.
The backend upload/storage handler returns a response body that satisfies the v3 candid/API contract the frontend actor client expects.
After a successful upload, the user is redirected to the feed and the newly uploaded content appears.
Error states (oversized file, unsupported format) still display user-friendly error messages rather than a v3 response body parse error.

constraints: Do not modify files listed under frontend.immutablePaths (useInternetIdentity, useActor, main.tsx, ui components).
All backend logic must remain in the single main actor file (backend/main.mo).
nonGoals: Changing the upload UI design or adding new upload fields.
Modifying any feature unrelated to the upload response parsing error.
